name: Okuhara Foods Inc
old_description: Home of Hawai'i's original fishcake, Okuhara Foods has been a local staple since 1946.
about:
Okuhara Foods Inc. operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, where it was founded in 1946 as a family-owned business. The company began as a modest operation producing fishcake, a traditional Japanese staple made from pureed white fish that is seasoned, shaped, and steamed until firm.

Today, the manufacturer produces a range of seafood-based products including its signature fishcake (kamaboko), customer-favorite Misoyaki Butterfish, and pre-marinated salmon fillets. The production process centers on fish pureeing, seasoning, forming, and steaming, along with marination and ready-to-cook meal preparation. Products are packaged for retail distribution.

Okuhara Foods supplies grocery retailers across Hawaii, with its products stocked at chains such as Times, Don Quijote, Marukai, and Big Save. The company serves the local consumer market and the broader foodservice sector seeking authentic Japanese-style seafood items.

The company emphasizes its heritage as Hawaii’s original fishcake maker, blending tradition with innovation to maintain a trusted presence in the community for over 75 years.
built_on: Blending tradition with innovation in seafood products
type_evidence: What began as a humble family business has grown into a go-to source for premium fishcake products
